scope: Settlement-engine submission of verified Solana V4 transaction and bank evidence
issue_fixed: The relayer could verify Solana V4 evidence but deliberately refused settlement submission; the settlement engine had no route that consumed the verified transaction-and-bank package.
implementation: Add a bounded portable Solana settlement envelope shared by the relayer and settlement engine.
Carry proof id, asset id, amount, sender, recipient, beneficiary, and the V4 payload through the settlement proof.
Derive the transaction commitment, finalized slot, transaction index, and finalized blockhash from the V4 payload and compare each with the surrounding SettlementProof fields.
Require the V4 cluster to match the settlement chain id.
Bind the proof to an intent leg with the same external chain, canonical asset id, and amount.
Construct the governance-configured Solana stake verifier from the gateway committee and persisted finalized-slot floor.
Persist a newly accepted finalized slot through the runtime provider before settlement submission succeeds.
Sign submit_proof through the existing runtime signer and serialize nonce acquisition with other settlement submissions.
Repair the settlement BTC proof benchmark to populate a contiguous best chain with the configured confirmation depth.

negative_and_boundary_tests: A portable evidence package refuses trailing or truncated bytes.
A wrong amount, asset id, transaction commitment, or Solana cluster is refused.
A zero runtime intent is refused before signer lookup.
SVM settlement refuses when no local runtime signer is configured.
The runtime returns no V4 verifier before a governance committee is installed.
The runtime advances the persisted finalized-slot floor only from accepted V4 evidence.
The live runtime continues to refuse the legacy unbound SVM proof shape.
limitations: No live Solana transaction or live X3 settlement extrinsic was submitted in this evidence run.
The relayer still needs a production vote-exchange transport for independent validators.
The standalone relayer executable still needs to be replaced by RelayerService.
Generated finality weights and public-chain canaries remain outstanding.
